pages.title: Cuphead Devil Standing with His Three-pronged Trident Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil standing with his three-pronged trident, curved horns, clawed feet, and a wide grin beneath his pointed nose. His arrow-tipped tail curls between his legs on this coloring sheet. The plain background leaves broad areas inside the furry silhouette, with smaller sections in the horns, teeth, and trident.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Sitting on His Skull Throne Inside the Casino Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil sits on his skull throne in this printable coloring page, resting his claws on skull-shaped armrests beneath a tall, pointed throne back. Casino tables, columns, and sweeping arches fill the room behind him. The coloring sheet combines broad character shapes with smaller architectural details and the curved divisions of the tiled floor.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Offering Cuphead and Mugman a Wager at the Casino Dice Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Cuphead's Devil offering Cuphead and Mugman a wager, extending one hand over dice and chips on a casino table. The brothers look up at him with open mouths and raised gloves. Chandeliers, draped curtains, and columned arches add detailed background sections around the large figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Handing Cuphead and Mugman a Scroll Listing His Runaway Debtors Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil presents a scroll of runaway debtors to Cuphead and Mugman in this printable coloring page, displaying three outlined figures between the rolled ends. The brothers stand below with worried expressions as he grins above them. Flame bowls, stone steps, and pointed arches frame the scene, adding narrow background spaces to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Listening to King Dice Report on the Brothers Collecting Soul Contracts Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil listening to King Dice report on soul contracts, with rolled scrolls tucked under the dice-headed character's arm. The Devil props his cheek on one hand while sitting on a skull-decorated throne. King Dice's bow tie, suit lapels, and numbered head give this coloring sheet smaller details beside the broad throne and figure shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Demanding the Soul Contracts From Cuphead and Mugman in His Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil demands the soul contracts in this printable coloring page, pointing from his throne toward Cuphead and Mugman as the brothers hold a scroll. His bared teeth and lowered brows face their anxious expressions. Flames rise behind a bone-trimmed throne, while the raised platform and cracked stone floor add larger outlined sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Using His Trident to Summon Four Bouncing Crystal Balls Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Cuphead's Devil summoning four bouncing crystal balls, gripping his trident while seated above the orbs on his pointed throne. Curved motion marks and impact strokes surround the round shapes across the foreground. Tall arches and cracked floor tiles frame the coloring sheet, contrasting broad circular areas with the Devil's jagged fur edges.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Conjuring Four Fire Spirits Orbiting a Fifth Above the Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil conjures five fire spirits in this printable coloring page, with four smaller grinning flames circling a larger one above his horned head. He sits holding his trident before a pointed throne, surrounded by columns and arched wall panels. The coloring sheet offers distinct flame shapes, triangular teeth, and broad open areas across the seated figure.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Commanding Small Purple Demons Running Out From Behind His Throne Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil commanding small demons from his throne, pointing sideways while horned imps run out around both sides of the seat. Several imps have little wings and outstretched arms, with flames rising behind them. The skull-like throne crest and upright trident add tall shapes above the busy running figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in His Skeleton Form Descending Through a Floor Opening in the Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil descends through a floor opening in his skeleton form on this printable coloring page, exposing curved ribs, a segmented spine, and clawed fingers. His horned skull grins above the cracked circular rim, with the empty throne visible behind him. The coloring sheet pairs narrow spaces between bones with broad floor tiles, curtains, and throne panels.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in His Giant Form Summoning a Spiraling Axe Between His Joined Eyes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil in giant form summoning a spiraling axe between his eyes, with curved motion lines sweeping around its handle. His raised claws frame a wide mouth full of pointed teeth. The close-up coloring sheet has large facial sections, striped horns, and smaller enclosed spaces along the axe blades and fingertips.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in His Giant Form Releasing a Winged Bat Bomb From His Ear Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's giant Devil releases a winged bat bomb from his ear in this printable coloring page, grinning beneath tall horns and sharply lowered brows. The round bomb has a short fuse and two spread wings, with motion strokes beside the ear. Broad facial spaces dominate the coloring sheet, while teeth and fur tips provide smaller details.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Towering Behind Five Stone Platforms as Cuphead Dodges a Falling Flaming Poker Chip Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Cuphead's Devil towering over five stone platforms as Cuphead leaps away from a falling poker chip surrounded by curling flames. The Devil's raised claws stretch above the small running figure. Cracks and falling fragments divide the floating rocks into angular sections, while the large face provides broad coloring areas on the sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Watching Two Large Flying Demons Spit Skulls Across the Three Remaining Platforms Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil watches two flying demons spit skulls across three platforms in this printable coloring page, his giant grinning face looming above the action. The demons spread their batlike wings and reach forward with clawed hands. Three cracked floating rocks and small falling fragments line the bottom of the coloring sheet beneath the airborne skulls.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil with Winged Imps Swarming Above His Forehead During the Final Boss Battle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil during the final boss battle, with three winged imps flying above his forehead between widely spaced curved horns. The smaller demons have raised claws, arrow-tipped tails, and outstretched wings. Their compact details contrast with the broad face and large triangular teeth filling most of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Crying Giant Tears Above Cuphead on the Last Remaining Stone Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil cries giant tears in this printable coloring page while Cuphead stands below on the last stone platform, looking upward with his arms spread. Large teardrops fall from the Devil's closed eyes around an open, fanged mouth. The coloring sheet contrasts the enormous face with the small figure and cracked edges of the single floating rock.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Holding His Injured Head with a Bandage Around His Broken Horn After Defeat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Cuphead's Devil after defeat, sitting with one hand against his injured head and a bandage wrapped around his broken horn. His drooping eyelids and downturned mouth accompany a slumped pose, while his arrow-tipped tail curves behind him. Broad body shapes and clearly separated claws keep the coloring sheet focused on the seated character.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Grinning Behind Evil Cuphead and Evil Mugman in the Bad Ending Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil grins behind Evil Cuphead and Evil Mugman in this printable coloring page, with both brothers displaying small horns, pointed teeth, and reaching gloves. The Devil crouches behind them with claws resting on his knees and his tail rising at one side. The coloring sheet groups three figures against a plain background, emphasizing faces, straws, and hands.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Watching Cuphead Win at Soul Ball Through His Underworld Periscope Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show watching Cuphead win at Soul Ball through a periscope mounted inside his rocky underworld. A circular inset shows Cuphead raising his fists beside the ball machine. Riveted pipe joints, jagged cave walls, and winding stone steps add geometric and irregular sections around the Devil on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Wearing a Top Hat and Tailcoat During His Underworld Musical Number Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show performs his underworld musical number in this printable coloring page, tipping a top hat above his bow-tied tailcoat. One hand opens toward the audience as musical notes float around him. Tied-back curtains and floorboards frame the full-length pose, giving the coloring sheet broad clothing panels and narrow stage details.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Chasing Cuphead and Mugman Through the Carnival with His Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show chasing Cuphead and Mugman through the carnival, carrying his pitchfork as both brothers flee. Their open mouths and lifted shoes emphasize the chase. A Ferris wheel, striped tents, flags, and hanging bunting surround the running figures, adding small repeated shapes behind the main action on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Staring at the Broken Soul Ball Machine as Captured Souls Escape Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show stares at a broken Soul Ball machine in this printable coloring page as three captured souls float from its cracked casing. He reaches toward the damaged game with an open mouth. Scattered fragments, round balls, and rows of targets give the coloring sheet small details beneath the larger ghost shapes and carnival tents.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Raising a Toast at His Underworld Party as Stickler Arrives with a Ledger Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Devil from The Cuphead Show raising a party toast as Stickler arrives beside him carrying a large, closed ledger. The Devil lifts a decorated goblet and rests his other hand on his hip. Balloons and triangular bunting frame the two figures, with Stickler's glasses, bow tie, and book edges adding smaller coloring-sheet details.

pages.title: Cuphead Facing the Devil with a Sparkling Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show recoils from Cuphead's protective forcefield in this printable coloring page, raising both hands while Mugman stands beside his brother. Sparkles surround the circular shield as Cuphead holds his palms outward. Bare trees, scattered stones, and cracked ground establish the scorched forest, leaving open background spaces around the three figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Magically Painting Elder Kettle's Picket Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show magically painting Elder Kettle's picket fence, directing a floating brush beside the cottage window. Sparkles surround the brush while paint drips down a pointed fence board. A handled paint bucket, grass tufts, and small shrubs add details below the broad wooden slats on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Laughing at Cuphead's Jokes While Waiting in Line for the Obliterator Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show laughs at Cuphead's jokes in this printable coloring page while they wait beside the queue ropes for the Obliterator. Cuphead gestures upward as the Devil holds his stomach with his eyes closed. The roller coaster's steep track and crossed supports form a detailed backdrop behind the two large figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil and Henchman with a Cotton Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show seated on his throne while Henchman reaches up with a cotton ball to treat his fur. The Devil crosses his legs beneath a flame-shaped throne back, looking toward his small winged helper. Pointed cave formations and cracked platform edges add angular sections around the rounded figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Receiving a Tea Trolley From Henchman Beside the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show receives a tea trolley from Henchman in this printable coloring page, sitting in an armchair beside a large, burning fireplace. A lidded teapot and cup rest on the wheeled cart as Henchman grips its handle. The coloring sheet includes scalloped crockery trim, fireplace bricks, a circular rug, and broad chair cushions.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Inspecting the Powerful Demons Summoned to Capture Cuphead Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Devil from The Cuphead Show inspecting three powerful demons summoned to capture Cuphead, gesturing toward them inside his throne room. The group includes a broad, spiked demon, a tall winged figure, and a shorter demon with folded arms. Pointed arches, columns, and a raised throne frame the contrasting body shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Searching Beside a Tree for His Misplaced Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show searches beside a tree for his misplaced pitchfork in this printable coloring page, holding one hand above his eyes. The three-pronged pitchfork leans against the opposite side of the trunk, surrounded by grass tufts. Broad foliage clusters and long bark lines add outdoor details around his searching pose on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Confronting Cuphead and Mugman Beside the Carved Faces of Mount Mugmore Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show confronting Cuphead and Mugman at Mount Mugmore, gesturing beneath the brothers' enormous carved faces. The brothers look up with open mouths and raised gloves as he grins beside them. Layered cliffs, pine trees, pebbles, and grass divide the mountain setting into varied sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Beside an Imp with a Giant Spoon Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show looks unimpressed in this printable coloring page as Henchman offers him an enormous spoon in place of his pitchfork. He folds his arms and frowns while Henchman holds the long handle with both hands. Pointed arches and jagged cave walls surround the contrasting figures and oversized utensil on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Slipping on Mugman's Scattered Marbles in the Underworld Corridor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Devil from The Cuphead Show slipping on Mugman's scattered marbles, spreading his arms as one foot slides across the corridor. Striped marbles spill from an open drawstring bag near his claws. The arched passage, columns, and long floor tiles add straight-edged sections behind the tilted, startled figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Trading Mugman Back to Cuphead in Exchange for His Stolen Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show trades Mugman back to Cuphead in this printable coloring page, sharing a grip on the recovered pitchfork beneath a stone arch. Mugman stands nearby smiling as Cuphead looks upward toward the Devil. The long trident shaft divides the grouped figures, while cracked stones and cave outlines add background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Using His Recovered Pitchfork to Restore His Shattered Throne Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show using his recovered pitchfork to restore his shattered throne, with broken pieces floating above its platform. Sparkles surround the raised trident and the separated cushions, armrests, and pointed finials. The coloring sheet combines the Devil's full-length pose with angular fragments, tufted upholstery, and broad curved steps.

pages.title: The Devil Singing on Stage in a Crown and Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show sings opera in his prince costume on this printable coloring page while Henchman applauds and small demons sleep behind him. A crown, fringed shoulder decorations, and a long cape distinguish his stage outfit. Musical notes and sleeping marks sit between tied curtains, giving the coloring sheet both large fabric panels and small costume details.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in a Top Hat and Heeled Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Devil from The Cuphead Show auditioning for Sally Stageplay, dancing in high-heeled boots while tipping a tall top hat. Sally watches with a clipboard beside the stage curtains as sparkles surround his pose. Broad boot shapes contrast with narrow heels, floorboard lines, and the scalloped edge of Sally's dress on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Devil with Cuphead and Mugman in Trash Bins Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show sits in a trash bin in this printable coloring page, flanked by separate bins holding Cuphead and Mugman outside the theater. All three rest their hands along the rims, with their heads and straws rising above the containers. Fluted bin panels, curtained doors, and rows of round entrance lights create repeated details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Discovering His Prized Possessions Trapped Inside Bubbles of Failure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show discovering prized possessions trapped in bubbles of failure, reaching toward a pitchfork, crown, and throne. Each object floats inside a separate round bubble with outlined highlights. His wide eyes, open mouth, and spread claws fill the foreground, while arched columns and stone tiles frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Wearing a Bow as Mrs. Meow Meow While Curled on Elder Kettle's Lap Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show appears as Mrs. Meow Meow in this printable coloring page, wearing a bow while curled on Elder Kettle's lap. Elder Kettle sits in a cushioned armchair and strokes the small horned figure, whose arrow-tipped tail curves across his knees. Flowers, tied window curtains, and an oval rug furnish the cottage coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Batting a Ball of Yarn Inside Elder Kettle's Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show batting a ball of yarn inside Elder Kettle's cottage, crouching on a round rug. His claws rest against the wrapped strands while a loose yarn end trails toward the foreground. A patched armchair, curtained window, and stone fireplace add varied textures around the playful pose on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Playing Tic-tac-toe with the Living Telephone Outside the Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show plays tic-tac-toe with a living telephone in this printable coloring page, holding a pencil above the game on their table. The smiling telephone points toward the grid, with its rotary dial above its eyes and receiver across its head. Chairs, garden shrubs, and the cottage's round-windowed door surround the outdoor coloring-sheet scene.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Wearing a Striped Scarf While Admiring a Toy Train in a Shop Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the Devil from The Cuphead Show admiring a toy train in a shop window, clasping his hands above a striped scarf. The locomotive sits on a curved track among wrapped gifts and a teddy bear. Snow rests on the sill, nearby roofs, and a wreath-decorated streetlamp, adding winter details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Asking Santa Claus for a Toy Train Beside the Naughty List Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show asks Santa Claus for a toy train in this printable coloring page, pointing toward the locomotive beside the open Naughty List. Santa holds the train above a large book of outlined rows and boxes. Wrapped presents, a teddy bear, and a toy sack furnish the room, adding smaller shapes around both figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Santa Riding a Sleigh Pulled by a Winged Imp Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show in magical Santa form, riding a gift-filled sleigh pulled through the sky by flying Henchman. He holds the reins above curved sleigh runners as Henchman stretches forward in a harness. A crescent moon, stars, clouds, and snowy rooftops frame the airborne figures on this Christmas coloring sheet.

pages.title: Santa Giving Cuphead a Toy Train Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show gives Cuphead a toy train in this printable coloring page, appearing in magical Santa form beside the cottage Christmas tree. Cuphead reaches out with both gloves toward the locomotive. Round ornaments, bead garlands, bows, and candy canes fill the tree behind them, while wrapped gifts and an oval rug complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil Riding a Train with Henchman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Devil from The Cuphead Show riding Henchman's train around the throne room, waving in a conductor's cap, vest, and scarf. Henchman operates the little locomotive ahead of the Devil's passenger car. Repeated wheels and track ties add small details beneath the figures, while a tall tufted throne rises behind them on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Devil and Ms. Chalice Tap Dancing on Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show competes against Ms. Chalice in this printable coloring page, tap-dancing on a curtained stage beside the large Applaud-o-meter gauge. Both wear bow ties and lift a shoe during the dance. The gauge's needle, round rim lights, Ms. Chalice's ruffled skirt, and the outlined shoe soles provide distinct smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Playing Rock-paper-scissors Against Cuphead to Settle Ms. Chalice's Deal Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Devil from The Cuphead Show playing rock-paper-scissors against Cuphead to settle Ms. Chalice's deal, with Ms. Chalice watching between them. The Devil holds out a closed fist while Cuphead presents an open glove. Ms. Chalice clasps her hands beneath her face, framed by hanging stage curtains and straight floorboards on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Devil Leaving the Dance Contest in His Elevator with Henchman Coloring Page
pages.description: The Devil from The Cuphead Show leaves the dance contest in this printable coloring page, standing inside his elevator while Henchman reaches toward the button panel. The Devil frowns with one hand on his hip as his small winged companion smiles. A trident emblem, decorative wall panels, and circular buttons add geometric details around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in Esther Winchester Desert Town Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil standing in Esther Winchester's desert town, wearing a long cape with spiked cuffs and holding his upright trident. Western storefronts, cacti, and distant flat-topped mountains surround his full-length pose. The coloring sheet balances broad cloak panels with smaller spikes, plank siding, scattered stones, and an outlined sun above the dusty street.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in Devil Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil sits in his throne room on this printable coloring page, resting clawed hands on carved demon heads beneath a back decorated with skulls and flames. His cape drapes over the seat as pointed horns rise toward the arched throne top. Stone-block walls, narrow windows, and cracked floor tiles provide additional outlined sections around the centered figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil in Howling Aces Airfield Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Cuphead's Devil at the Howling Aces airfield, wearing aviator goggles, a flight helmet, and a buttoned jacket while holding his trident. A propeller plane and star-marked hangar stand behind him, with mountains beyond. Wing-shaped jacket badges, pockets, and a wrapped scarf add smaller details within the broad portrait shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil on Theater Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead's Devil stands on a theater stage in this printable coloring page, posing with both hands on his hips beneath curved horns and a raised cape collar. Tied curtains, a hanging spotlight, and a brick wall with an arched window frame his grin. The coloring sheet offers broad cape and torso areas alongside smaller curtain folds, teeth, and masonry outlines.

pages.title: Cuphead Devil on Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's Devil on a pirate ship, wearing a feathered skull-and-crossbones hat and a long captain's coat while holding his trident. A small pirate flag hangs from the shaft beside his curled fingers. Rigging, a furled sail, deck planks, and the ship's railing add repeated lines behind his full-length pose on this coloring sheet.
